name: Advance Grinding
verdict: The biggest movement is a 92.31% drop in GBP activity over the last 7 days compared to the prior 7 days, likely driven by reduced local search visibility or a seasonal dip in demand for grinding services. Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend and zero leads over the full 28-day window, meaning GBP's 128 actions, 3 calls, and 87 direction requests are the only lead-gen activity keeping the account alive.

performance.verdict: GBP collapse and 6 overdue SOW milestones are the real risk, not paid media.

findings.text: 4 CRM milestones overdue since July 7–31: 1st Directives, Tom call list, dedup workbook, and 126 accounts — all unconfirmed complete.
3 Aug-31 blockers overdue: 342 stub reconciliation (CRM), root cause fix (Web/SEO), and AGS+Forte contact pull (Outreach) — all gates for downstream work.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for the last 6 days (Sep 5–10), down from a peak of 17 on Aug 23; 7d delta is -92.31%.
Search clicks hit 0 on Sep 9–10 after averaging ~5/day across Aug; 7d delta -64% — organic visibility is deteriorating, not just GBP.
Zero paid spend and zero leads across the full 45-day series; GBP's 128 actions and 3 calls in 28 days are the only lead-gen activity in the account.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 3 Aug-31 blockers to Ahmed/Dev team immediately; zero downstream work can proceed without them.
suggestions.monday_update: Three confirmed blockers passed their Aug 31 deadline with no completion event: 342 stub reconciliation (CRM), root cause fix (Web/SEO), and AGS+Forte contact pull (Outreach). Each gates downstream builds — Sales-i pipeline, SEO corrections, and cold outreach respectively. Success check: all three show a completion post on the Monday board with rollback files or deliverables attached by 2026-09-18. Sohib to confirm with Ahmed, Dev 2, and the Outreach lead directly.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing health immediately; 0 actions for 6 consecutive days signals a possible suspension or listing issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 for Sep 5–10 (6 consecutive days) after averaging roughly 6–9 actions/day in late August, and search clicks also hit 0 on Sep 9–10. This pattern is consistent with a GBP suspension, a listing edit under review, or a local algorithm change — not a gradual seasonal decline. Check GBP dashboard for any warnings or pending verifications. Success check: root cause identified and documented in Monday by 2026-09-14; if suspended, reinstatement appeal filed same day.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP and search clicks over the next 3 days; if still zero by Sep 14, escalate as confirmed organic outage.
